name: Althii Archipelago
summary: The Althii Archipelago is two main low islands and a scatter of islets off the south-east coast, with Lilmoth at the southern end and the Three Waters town of Uluo on the north. Estates, farms and Imperial and Lilmothiit ruins fill the interior.
landform: Low islands of firm ground with inner marsh, hills of a few metres and sea-cut coasts
climate: Hot, humid, with sea winds and a monsoon

name: Aphon Isle
summary: Aphon Isle is a small island in Topal Bay with a belvedere, a signal tower and a smugglers' cave.
landform: island
climate: warm and breezy with salt spray

name: Arnesian Jungle
summary: The Arnesian Jungle is the humid, forested upland of the north-east, between Thorn on the coast and the mesa country to the south. It is the Stone-Sleepers' country: stone-built hamlets and a terraced city, a long inlet from the bay, Velothi ruins on the shores and a crimson-marked corner of Warden forts and camps round Thorn.
landform: Low forested uplands cut by a long tidal inlet from Thorn's bay, with rises, river terraces and shores
biome: Humid lowland jungle and riverine forest, with grassland at the Thorn end
climate: Warm, humid, with heavy summer rain and sea fog on the coast

name: Aunike Ridge
summary: Aunike Ridge is the long rise of drier ground west and south-west of Helstrom, with two peaks and a few Chime-Keeper hamlets. It is the interior's rare high ground and the line between the Hist forest and the Paatru country.
landform: A long low ridge of firm ground, rock outcrops and two summits, among reed marsh.
biome: Upland marsh ridge of rock outcrop, scrub, reed and a few stunted trees
climate: Warmer and drier than the forest, with steady breeze on the summits and monsoon rain from the north.

name: Banujha Basin
summary: The Banujha Basin is the wet interior behind Soulrest, held by the Mine-Burner tribes who burned the Imperial mines in 3E 427.
landform: flooded basin and river maze
climate: hot, humid, with monsoon

name: Barsaebica
summary: The ruin-studded high ground west of Stormhold, the Barsaebic Ayleids' old country, now home to the reed-wardens of Jal-Veesa and the frontier at Slough Point.
landform: hummocky marsh plain with sunken ruin mounds
climate: humid and warm; heavy rain; tides reach the western rivers

name: Benthic Yobesh
summary: Benthic Yobesh is the open sea floor east of the Althii islands where seven drowned spires, Echo Deep and the downed Kelp Lantern lie. Only Bell Station's divers work it.
landform: A sea floor of silt and coral flats with drowned spires and a deep trench
biome: Open sea floor, coral and kelp
climate: Warm shallow water over cold deep currents

name: Blackwood
summary: The western frontier of Black Marsh, the Blackwood end of the Gideon country: hills and bog with a few villages, Hutan-Tzel outposts and the dead Kothringi towns.
landform: bog and low hills
climate: humid; monsoon closes the western roads

name: Cape Percar
summary: Cape Percar is the western peninsula wrapping Topal Bay, Soulrest's hinterland of burned mines, quarries, timber camps and coastal villages. Drier and hillier than the washes east of it, it carries the burn scar of the Great Burn.
landform: A forested peninsula of low hills and coastal flats, cut by tidal creeks, with mines in the hills and a burn-scarred strip.
biome: Coastal swamp forest and mangrove, with drier red-gum hills
climate: Warm, humid, with sea breezes and mist from the Sea of Mists; wet season floods the creeks.

name: Chixathe Mesa
summary: Chixathe Mesa is a high, dry, flat-topped upland south of the Arnesian Jungle, with cliff edges, quarries and chalk pits, Velothi ruins and a Sarpa-held western edge. It is the quarry country of the Stone-Sleepers and the Wardens.
landform: Flat-topped mesas with cliff sides, cut by rivers, with quarries and chalk faces
biome: Dry upland scrub and stunted forest on the mesa tops, riverine jungle in the cuts
climate: Warm and drier than the jungle, with sharp winds on the heights

name: Hatandros Bight
summary: Hatandros Bight is the open bay and coastal plain south of Thorn, a strip of grassland, mud-flats and low clay rises with Cantemiric Velothi ruins on its headlands.
landform: coastal plain and bay shore
biome: temperate coastal grassland and salt marsh
climate: mild, humid; sea fog in the mornings and heavy rains in the monsoon season

name: Kotherra Mangroves
summary: The Kotherra Mangroves are the tidal delta country around Gideon, where mangrove channels, red-clay banks and the Blackwood Road meet Topal Bay.
landform: mangrove delta and tidal flat
climate: hot, humid, tidal; monsoon floods the road

name: Lake Ulaish
summary: Lake Ulaish is the great lake south-east of Helstrom where the interior waters pool before running to Lilmoth and Blackrose. Fishing hamlets, a toll fort and a trading city share its shores, and boats are its roads.
landform: A broad shallow lake with silt islets, reed shores and river deltas at its north-west corner.
biome: Shallow freshwater lake, reed beds, silt islets and delta marsh
climate: Humid and warm, with squalls across open water and monsoon flooding of the shores.

name: Murkwood
summary: Murkwood is the Hist forest at the heart of Black Marsh, the legendary dark wood that ever moves, around Helstrom. Its people are the Root-Folk, its beasts are medusas and Naga, and outsiders who enter without leave do not come out.
landform: Low swamp forest of root-hummocks, braided river arms and black Heart-Mud flats, with a few dry rises.
biome: Dense Hist swamp forest of great roots and hanging moss, black Heart-Mud flats and slow rivers
climate: Hot, humid and overcast, with flesh-fly clouds in the warm months and heavy monsoon rain from late spring.

name: Nha Enasa
summary: Nha Enasa is the drier river country north-east of Gideon, with Naka-Desh river stations, Kothringi ruins and the market town of Gul-Tej.
landform: river plain with low banks
climate: hot, humid; monsoon floods

name: Nushara Bayou
summary: The Nushara Bayou is the wet country of channels, reed beds and low hummocks behind the south-east coast between Archon and the Althii islands. The Three Waters Tribe lives on its rafts and stilts, and its back-water routes carry trade past the customs men.
landform: A bayou of braided channels, reed flats and low hummocks, open at its south edge to the strait
climate: Hot and humid year-round, with a monsoon and tidal flooding

name: Okuwun Rahei
summary: Okuwun-Rahei is the mound-and-lake country of the east interior, the home of the Clay-Mound People of Aroxhu, the Agaceph and the Spray-Folk of Seafalls.
landform: mound country, lakes and marsh
biome: clay mounds, lakes and marsh with tidal creeks
climate: hot, wet and humid, with monsoon floods that cut roads for days

name: Padomaic Ocean
summary: The Padomaic Ocean is the open sea off Black Marsh's eastern coast, where Skeith Isle's pirates and the coast boats work and the wrecks of three eras lie on the shelf.
landform: continental shelf and open sea
climate: windy and wet; storms and sea-mist off the shelf, calm in the dry season

name: Sea of Mists
summary: The Sea of Mists is the Southern Sea off Black Marsh's south coast, between Cape Percar and the Lilmoth coast, held under a low mist most mornings. Wrecks, small islands and a lighthouse mark it.
landform: Shallow shelf sea with sandbars and low islets off a drowned coast.
climate: Warm, humid, with sea mist on most mornings and storms in the wet season.

name: Skeith Isle
summary: Skeith Isle is a rugged island off the Okuwun-Rahei coast, dark grey-green rock, held by pirates and smugglers and topped by an old Imperial keep.
landform: rocky island
climate: windy and salt-laden, drier than the mainland

name: Topal Bay
summary: Topal Bay is the placid bay on the west coast, notorious for piracy on its eastern shore and the route to Soulrest and Gideon.
landform: sea
climate: warm, humid, with sea breeze and storms

name: Tulmek Washes
summary: The Tulmek Washes are the flooded lowland between Soulrest's cape and the Lilmoth delta, centred on Blackrose's lake and its three rivers. A mosaic of channels, islands and ruins, it is the hinge of the south.
landform: Flat flooded lowland of river channels, lakes, mud islands and small dry rises, with the Blackrose lake at its heart.
climate: Hot, wet and still; annual flood cycle with boardwalk decks above wet-season level.

name: Ultherus Swamp
summary: The Ultherus Swamp is the great wetland south of Helstrom, in which the Kothringi-named town of Korydon lies. Canon says little of it except that the lovely and deadly dragon's-tongue is especially common there.
landform: A low wet maze of channels, hummocks and cattail beds, with rings of firmer ground.
biome: Cattail and reed swamp with dragon's-tongue beds, hummocks and braided channels
climate: Hot, humid and heavy, with monsoon rain and constant insects.

name: Valley of Storms
summary: The Shadowfen's northern frontier country around Stormhold: a rolling, ravine-cut plain of mounds, reed beds and river branches beside the Morrowind border.
landform: rolling river plain of mounds and ravines
climate: humid; heavy summer rain; monsoon closes the causeways
